assessment: All five functions pass their tests and route correctly. The integration pass shows one finding on the described design, V-EOLPWR, which is a property of the design and is correct behavior. One function does not meet a non-functional requirement.
emergent_effects: Transmit power belongs to the link element, and it moves the power margin and the bulk temperature through X-1 and X-2. A link fix by raising power costs power margin.
Array area belongs to the power element, and it moves mass headroom through X-3. The power shortfall cannot be fixed with area alone without checking mass.
Shielding thickness improves the radiation margin and costs mass headroom through X-3.

redesign.instruction: PARAMETERS['internal_power_w'] reads 'Heat dissipated inside the spacecraft'. It does not state the unit. The requirement is that units appear in every parameter description. State W, and add a test that every description states a unit so this cannot regress.

lessons: A missing unit in a parameter description passes every numeric test. Check every schema against the non-functional requirements by reading it.
When the transmitter is an electrical load, a link change is also a power and thermal change. Look at X-1 before approving either.
